title: Multi-Signal Adaptive Search Controller v2
v2_changes: Keep the unified uncertainty architecture but make it ablation-friendly.
Use controller output only for LMR and child-node futility in v2.
Return null-move pruning and razoring to parent behavior.
Reduce root-volatility and root-churn contribution to uncertainty.
Reduce LMR amplitude by roughly half versus v1.
Activate the controller only from depth 11 upward to protect the hot shallow tree.
Use smoother thresholds so low/high confidence effects are less abrupt.

screen.termination: GitHub Actions job timeout at 210 minutes during game 360; no engine crash detected.

promotion.basis: Promoted by project owner after a positive but incomplete paired parent screen. The partial result is descriptive and is not treated as a completed 600-game confirmation.
promotion.next_protocol: All new FayE feature/tuning experiments start from the promoted FayE baseline and are evaluated against official-stockfish/Stockfish master fetched at run time.

decision_policy: Promoted as the new FayE baseline by project decision. Continue tuning and new architecture work from this baseline; future candidate-vs-reference tests use Stockfish latest rather than the pre-FAYE parent.
